21 def pose_to_list(pose):
22  """
23  Take a ROS Pose and return it as a Python list [x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw]

28  :rtype: list[float]

37 def list_to_pose(list_):
38  """
39  Take a Pose as a Python list [x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw] and return a ROS Pose

100 def angle_between_2_points(p1, p2):
101  np_point1 = np.array([p1.x, p1.y, p1.z])
102  np_point2 = np.array([p2.x, p2.y, p2.z])
103 
104  unit_vector_1 = np_point1 / np.linalg.norm(np_point1)
105  unit_vector_2 = np_point2 / np.linalg.norm(np_point2)
106  dot_product = np.dot(unit_vector_1, unit_vector_2)
107  angle = np.arccos(dot_product)
108 
109  return angle

160 def invert_quat(q):
161  q_inv = copy.deepcopy(q)
162  if isinstance(q_inv, Quaternion):
163  q_inv.w = -q.w
164  elif isinstance(q_inv, list):
165  q_inv[3] = -q[3]
166  else:
167  raise TypeError
168  return q_inv

171 def diff_quat(q1, q2):
172  q1_list = [q1.x, q1.y, q1.z, q1.w] if isinstance(q1, Quaternion) else q1
173  q2_list = [q2.x, q2.y, q2.z, q2.w] if isinstance(q2, Quaternion) else q2
174 
175  q2_inv = invert_quat(q2_list)
176 
177  return quaternion_multiply(q1_list, q2_inv)

180 def get_orientation_from_angles(r, p, y):
181  quaternion = quaternion_from_euler(r, p, y)
182  orientation = Quaternion()
183  orientation.x = quaternion[0]
184  orientation.y = quaternion[1]
185  orientation.z = quaternion[2]
186  orientation.w = quaternion[3]
187  return orientation

190 def get_rpy_from_quaternion(rot):
191  euler = euler_from_quaternion(rot)
192  # Force angles in [-PI, PI]
193  for i, angle in enumerate(euler):
194  if angle > np.pi:
195  euler[i] = angle % (2 * np.pi) - 2 * np.pi
196  elif angle < -np.pi:
197  euler[i] = angle % (2 * np.pi)
198  return euler
